CustomField.label: Formula Result Type
CustomField.description: Declares the return type for Query comparison formulas: Expected Value (Formula) and Value to find in the list (formula). Leave Automatic unless the shared type is verified. Pass Condition and applicability formulas return Checkbox; display formulas detect their own type.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Leave Automatic unless you know the return type of your Query comparison formulas (expected value or value to find). Does not control Pass Condition, applicability, or display formulas.
